## Verdict: PASS

The one failing line, N-56 (5) Q28 (the digest half), is fixed. Its named fault is killed by the item's own pins and
by this seat's probes. Every gate is green in scope. RELATED's two reds are the brief's known foreign reds, and they
are unchanged with the round's change neutralised. No new finding is a blocker. Three notes were appended
(`M0-d-04-notes.md` N-15 – N-17).
